name: Keyshop — No-Signup LLM Inference
description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions (kimi-k3, glm-5.2, deepseek, qwen). No account, no API key, no KYC — pay per call in USDC.
longDescription: Keyshop sells LLM inference with zero onboarding friction. Buyers POST a standard OpenAI-style chat completion request and get a live response from frontier open models (kimi-k3, glm-5.2, deepseek, qwen variants) — no account creation, no API key management, no credit card, no KYC. Payment is per-request via x402 (USDC on Base). Built for AI agents that need inference mid-task without provisioning provider accounts, and for developers who want one-off model calls without signup walls. Key rotation and failover are handled server-side; dead keys are benched automatically. Health endpoint reports live pool status.
